name: Approval Actions (one-tap)
_setup_notes: Import this file into n8n via Settings → Import workflow.
Handles the Approve/Reject buttons that ntfy approval pushes carry.
Required nodes to configure after import:
1. Webhook — POST /webhook/approval-action; query params: id, action, exp, sig.
Set APPROVAL_ACTION_URL in infra/env/.env to this webhook's full URL.
(verification happens in Python: HMAC signature, expiry, single-use).
3. Respond to Webhook — 200 with the decision JSON on success; 400 with the
error message when the command exits non-zero.
Security: the webhook does NO decision logic itself — a request with a bad or
